notes.title: Rack N Ruin Soundtrack is now available on Steam! 40% off launch discount!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 

Its been some time in the making, and now Rack N Ruin's wonderful soundtrack is available on the Steam Store!.  Enjoy 18 Tracks from the game composed by Ben Briggs.  Rack n Ruin's soundtrack features a wide arrange of musical themes, and tones, from haunting hymns to epic metal infused boss anthems. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/400600/

notes.title: Rack N Ruin v1.02 is live.
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Rack N Ruin v1.02 is now live on Steam for Windows, Mac, and Linux.  

Fix/Change List
-Ending no longer cuts out mid credits
-Spike Box now resets position on the puzzle outside Amon's Castle.
-Stone door blocking the entrance to the the Fisherman's ghost is can no longer be forced through.
-Rooted Gauntlet wave spawner now resets properly after the player dies.
-First right facing block in the Heart of the World can no longer be pushed into the room below it.
-Lightning and other abilities have better implemented right thumbstick aiming. 
-Apply changes option added to the gameplay menu.
-Hellfire Tornado exploit has been removed. 
-The bomb wall at the top of The Desert of the Nesting Pheonix can no longer be pushed through.
-Baba Yaga achievement has been fixed to trigger properly instead of too early as achievable before. 
-Hardmode's difficulty has been increased by reducing the use of check-pointing only in hardmode.  

Potential Fix list (these fixes may not solve all cases of these problems occurring, the bugs are still open please report any of these if you see them).
-Quitting to main menu in full screen mode blacking out some video card setups.
-Taking damage while walking between rooms resulting in an infinite damage lock. 
- Amon's Throne room ambush sometimes not triggering the cutscene, thus has to be re-initiated again.

Next update will have Polish translations.  The Soundtrack and Wallpappers are also coming soon.  

Sincerely,
Everyone at Lifespark Entertainment

notes.title: Rack N Ruin v1.01 is live.
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,  

I hope everyone is enjoying Rack N Ruin.  We have pushed a small patch to fix a few bugs that have shown up in the launch of the PC release.  Here is the fix list.  If anyone experiences any issues,  email tylerhunter@lifesparkent.com  and I will get working on the next update.


Notable Bug Fixes
- The Wisp Dust exploit can no longer be used (sorry speed runners)
- The jump off the wall, offsetting Rack's Sprite and HitBox should be fixed, contact me if this bug happens to you post update.
- Music occasionally not playing when some levels load should be fixed entirely,  contact me if you music isn't playing post update. 
- Check point causing the player to be set to the wrong sorting layer in the Burning Nest area is fixed.  
- Players can no longer walk outside the level geometry in the Molten Crag area. 

Features
- 16:10 resolution support added.

Thanks again for playing Rack N Ruin.

Sincerely,
Everyone at Lifespark Entertainment
